name: Web App
description: Customer-facing web front end for booking appointments, checking out, and searching providers.

name: Checkout API
description: Builds carts, applies pricing, and orchestrates payment for bookings that require a deposit.

name: Payment Gateway
description: Authorizes and captures card payments through the card processor and records payment intents.

name: Billing
description: Manages subscription plans for business customers and generates monthly invoices.

name: Auth
description: Issues and validates session tokens and terminates mutual TLS for internal service callers.

name: Scheduling API
description: Owns availability, bookings, and rescheduling rules for every provider calendar.

name: Calendar Sync
description: Background workers that sync bookings with providers' external calendar accounts.

name: Notifications
description: Sends booking confirmations, reminders, and receipts by email and SMS from a queue.

name: Search Index
description: Full-text index behind provider and service search in the web app, rebuilt from the core database.

name: Core Database
description: Primary relational database cluster holding accounts, bookings, and payment records.
